title: Agentic Security Testing for Web Apps and APIs
summary: Supervisor-led AI agents map your web app and APIs, test OWASP Top 10, API and business-logic flaws, confirm each issue live, and hand tester-reviewed findings with evidence to your team.

seo.title: Agentic Security Testing for Web Apps and APIs | VipraTech
seo.description: AI agents that map, test and confirm web app and API vulnerabilities across OWASP Top 10, API risks and business logic, with tester-reviewed findings.

problem.intro: SaaS teams ship web and API changes every week, but a full manual pentest happens once or twice a year. Scanners run more often but produce long lists of unverified issues and miss business-logic flaws, such as a user approving their own expense claim or reading another account's invoice by changing an ID.

pain_points.title: Pentests that age quickly
pain_points.detail: Last year's report says little about the endpoints and roles added since.

pain_points.title: Scanner noise
pain_points.detail: Unverified scanner output buries real issues and costs engineers time on false positives.

pain_points.title: Business logic missed
pain_points.detail: Authorisation and workflow flaws need an understanding of roles and intent that signature-based scanners lack.

pain_points.title: Weak evidence
pain_points.detail: Findings without a reproducible path are hard for developers to fix and hard for customers to trust.

solution.overview: We build and run an agentic testing workflow for your web application and APIs. A supervisor agent plans the engagement and directs specialist agents: one discovers endpoints from crawling, OpenAPI or GraphQL schemas and traffic captures; another maps roles and the attack surface; others test for OWASP Top 10 and OWASP API Security Top 10 risks, such as broken object-level authorisation, and work through business-logic flows. Every candidate issue is confirmed live in a controlled way, so only real issues are reported, with the requests and responses that prove them. A human tester reviews findings, looks for chains across issues and rates severity. Findings can become draft fix pull requests for developer review.
capabilities: Endpoint discovery from crawling, OpenAPI or GraphQL schemas and traffic captures
Role and permission matrix testing across user types and tenants
OWASP Top 10 and OWASP API Security Top 10 coverage
Business-logic testing of workflows such as approvals, refunds and invitations
Live confirmation of each candidate issue with request and response evidence
Tester-reviewed findings, with optional draft fix pull requests

workflow.title: Agree scope and accounts
workflow.detail: We agree targets, environments, test accounts per role, rate limits and excluded actions.

workflow.title: Discover and map
workflow.detail: Agents discover endpoints and build a map of roles, objects and workflows.

workflow.title: Plan and test
workflow.detail: The supervisor assigns specialist agents to test each area against OWASP and business-logic cases.

workflow.title: Confirm live
workflow.detail: Each candidate issue is reproduced safely, and unconfirmed issues are dropped.

workflow.title: Tester review
workflow.detail: A human tester reviews confirmed issues, looks for chains and rates severity.

workflow.title: Report and fix
workflow.detail: Findings go to your tracker with evidence, and draft fix pull requests are prepared where useful.

inputs: Target URLs and API base paths in staging
OpenAPI or GraphQL schemas, where available
Test accounts for each role and tenant
outputs: Confirmed findings with request and response evidence
Draft fix pull requests for developer review
human_in_the_loop: A human tester reviews every confirmed finding, looks for chains and sets severity. Developers review and merge any draft fix pull request; nothing changes in your code without their approval.
integrations: Issue trackers such as Jira, Linear or GitHub Issues
Source repository for draft fix pull requests
guardrails: Agreed scope, exclusions and rate limits enforced by the tool layer
No destructive actions; state-changing tests only on test accounts
Every reported issue confirmed live before it is reported
All agent actions logged for audit
Stop control available to your team throughout
compliance_notes: Testing records support customer due diligence and audits against frameworks such as ISO/IEC 27001 and SOC 2, where regular pentesting is expected.
Findings map to the OWASP Top 10 and OWASP API Security Top 10.

pilot.scope: One web application and its main API in staging, with test accounts for two or three roles.
deliverables: Draft fix pull requests for selected findings

what_we_measure.how: Count of confirmed issues after tester review.
Candidates the tester rejects as not real, tracked to tune the agents.
Endpoints discovered and tested against known endpoints from schemas.
Time from ticket to passing retest, including draft pull requests.

faqs.q: Is this a replacement for a manual pentest?
faqs.a: It takes over much of the repetitive work and can run far more often, but a human tester still reviews findings, looks for chains and judges severity. Many teams use it between annual manual tests or as the base of a continuous programme.

faqs.q: Is it safe to run against our app?
faqs.a: Testing runs in staging with test accounts, within agreed rate limits and exclusions. Agents avoid destructive actions, and your team can stop a run at any time.
Yes, within the workflows you describe and the roles we have accounts for. Logic testing works best when your team walks us through how approvals, refunds or sharing should behave.
We can prepare draft fix pull requests for confirmed findings. Your developers review, test and merge them, and we retest afterwards.
